configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Everything the shell build shares: Ninja and the cached pinned dependency. The module set and the install layout stay at the shell/CMakeLists.txt defaults, so this file cannot freeze a stale copy of either; only `release` restates the layout, because it relocates it.

configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.description: Iterate locally: debug info, compile commands, and a build-local install root. Not offline, so the first configure may fetch the pinned M3Shapes revision itself.

configurePresets.name: source-offline
configurePresets.description: The build-parity CI job's source half: offline, Release, staged with DESTDIR against a / prefix because the install tree is compared artifact by artifact.

configurePresets.name: package-offline
configurePresets.description: The build-parity CI job's package half, identical to source-offline except for the package-only assets, so the two trees can be diffed.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: The prebuilt artifact the release job publishes: offline and Release, installed under usr/lib rather than the distro data root so the tarball carries one self-contained tree.

configurePresets.name: runtime
configurePresets.description: The runtime smoke harness's build. The caller overrides CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX with the workspace-relative install root it asserts against.

configurePresets.name: sanitizers
configurePresets.description: AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer for the C++ plugins and KWin effect, pinned to Debug so the reports stay readable.
